title: Game Theory and Applications in Economics - Business

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply game theory concepts to analyze economic and business scenarios.
Analyze economic theories and apply them to decision-making processes.
Use game theory to identify and evaluate equilibrium strategies in real-world situations.
Model economic and business situations using game theory frameworks.
Critically evaluate theoretical and practical issues in economics and business.
Work effectively in groups to solve problems and present findings.
Effectively communicate and defend game theory-based analyses and strategies.
Proactively engage in independent study and research.
Apply mathematical concepts to solve game theory problems.
Use Python for modeling and analyzing game theory scenarios.
Conduct research and analyze data to support game theory applications.
